extra.label_text: This code was written by Gemini.
issues: np.random.randint(min_val, max_val, ...) excludes max_val, so values are not drawn from the full specified range if the range is intended to include both endpoints.
min_val == max_val is unnecessarily rejected; a valid fixed-value DataFrame can be produced for that range.
rows and cols are not validated as integers, despite the error message saying they must be non-negative integers.
